t: What Flood Exposure Database Is All About
title: What Flood Exposure Database Is All About
description: Flood exposure is hazard meeting assets: FEMA's 100-year floodplain maps set insurance, but Harvey (2017, $125B) flooded far outside mapped zones — maps lag development and climate. Terrain (elevation, slope), infrastructure (levees, drainage), and people (density, vulnerability) combine. Buyouts move people out permanently; green infrastructure absorbs the rest. The Netherlands' Room for the River gave water space instead of fighting it. This database is the complete flood exposure record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
